canonical_name: FCM legacy HTTP and XMPP APIs
aliases: Firebase Cloud Messaging legacy HTTP API
still_usable_note: Firebase documents the legacy HTTP/XMPP sending APIs as deprecated with shutdown beginning July 22, 2024, while current Firebase references describe legacy upstream messaging as decommissioned. The exact date on which every legacy path became unavailable is not inferred.
summary: Firebase replaced the legacy FCM HTTP/XMPP sending APIs with the HTTP v1 API. Deprecation took effect June 20, 2023 and shutdown began July 22, 2024.
current_state: Legacy FCM sending paths are no longer the supported interface; HTTP v1 is the supported migration target.
known_unknowns: July 22, 2024 is documented as the start of shutdown, not necessarily the exact completion date for every legacy path.
notes: Avoids converting the documented shutdown-start date into an unsupported universal completion date.
